protocol: Three sequential interleaved original/final process rounds; each process runs three seeded 180-frame repetitions per mode after 60 idle warmup frames. Summary reports median of the three process medians and p95s. Active statistics exclude subsequent upright frames.
limitations: SSR CPU only; no GPU, browser, asset-loading, frame-pacing or render cost.
Original balance/PvP/contact automatically scattered pieces; final follows cause policy. These are whole Player path comparisons, not equivalent visual workloads.
Elapsed time depends on CPU scheduling and JIT. Use workload counts and correctness tests together with timing; do not claim meaningful gains from differences near a few percent.
Original source is the pre-task Player snapshot plus pre-task breakApart/bailRecovery. The policy module present in the original directory is not referenced by its Player.

The isolated release retains the upstream concave wall-path nearest-slice guard absent in the measured workspace player. This is the only Player source difference; the benchmark contains no wall-path components. The other measured runtime source hashes match the release.
